required_invariant: A well-framed bounded body rejected for Origin/Host must receive a complete HTTP rejection; no handler executes and a subsequent healthy request succeeds.

minimal_request.client_chunks: 16 chunks of 1024 header bytes followed by 64 chunks of 128 body bytes, TCP_NODELAY and 1 millisecond between chunks

baseline.fragmented_observation: BrokenPipeError [Errno 32] while client was sending the body; server had rejected the headers before consuming it
baseline.ordinary_http_client_observation: Ten sequential authenticated valid-form requests with foreign Origin gave 404,404,404,ConnectionResetError,ConnectionResetError,404,ConnectionResetError,404,ConnectionResetError,404
baseline.storage_observation: No records inserted; healthy GET succeeded after every ordinary-client attempt
